name: Clements Hills
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Lodi Zinfandels are known as juicy and approachable.

blurb.text: A Lodi sub-area in northern San Joaquin County around the town of Clements. It is one of seven smaller areas within Lodi.
